blockingFindings.description: V74 sit and crouch renders still expose both upper thighs broadly while the front panels hang below or beside the knees; the lap does not maintain continuous front coverage.
Sit and crouch show sharp triangular folds and overlapping purple hems clustered beside the knees, indicating a failed side transition between front and rear skirt panels.
Neutral, front and side views retain jagged vertical creases, stepped side ridges and an irregular elongated hem; the standing silhouette and panel surfaces remain visibly damaged.

outOfScope: VRChat Build & Test and runtime inspection
